Name: Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings RECOLOR  Shed and Big shed RETOUCH
Author: Bezzu33
Description:
I was using the Ali's collection of the rush fairy building mode and found that there was no retouching file for a large barn.
Therefore, we made a retacture of a large barn by referring to the existing small barn.

I also modified the small barn a little. (Really a little bit)

I hope it will be helpful for those who like this version of the retouch mode, including me.

How to use
1. Download the file.
2. File ctrl+c, ctrl+v in the path below.
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Buildings

Please understand that English is not smooth. (I'm Korean)


'Ali's recollection of the lush fairy building' 모드를 사용하고 있던 중 큰 헛간의 리텍스쳐 파일이 없다는 걸 발견했습니다
따라서 기존의 작은 헛간을 참고하여 큰 헛간의 리텍스쳐를 제작하였습니다.

겸사겸사 작은 헛간도 조금 수정했습니다. (진짜 조금)

저를 비롯해 이 버전의 리텍스쳐 모드를 좋아하는 분들에게 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다.
